integrity: Explicit kernel proof with independent rational integral cross-checks; tests are finite corroboration rather than infinite certificates; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform solid volume measure, real coordinate cube and cross-polytope, and the specified affine L2 orthogonal projector only.
No claims about higher degree, arbitrary unconditional bodies, surface measure or minimum projection constant.
A historically equivalent formula might appear in multivariate polynomial approximation literature under other terminology.
title: Polar-body instability of affine least-squares projection on cubes and cross-polytopes
